name: CtrlS Datacenters
notes: CtrlS is Asia’s Largest Rated-4 Hyperscale Data Center player operating one million square feet of Data Center space and trusted by 60 of the Fortune 500 Global Multinationals including 3 out of the 5 World’s largest hyperscalers and 4,000 customers worldwide.The company has had zero down time since inception, is certified as World’s First LEED Platinum Certified Rated 4 Data Center, and expanding its footprint to five million square feet in India & 9 other countries globally.
